messages.text: I have stopped the Bentley Continental GT on CD-420322. A red warning came on and the car felt different when accelerating.
Thank you for stopping. Are you and the vehicle in a safe place? Please do not drive it further while we contact the owner.
I am safe at a service-area car park. The engine is off. I can send a dashboard photo, but I have not diagnosed the issue.
Human owner required. Record the safe stop, get the photo and call the customer for instructions. No recovery booking or delivery promise yet.

Operations has a human coordinator on this. Please keep the vehicle stopped and send the service-area name or a safe location pin when you can. We are waiting for the owner's service instruction; nobody has cleared onward driving.
Please keep the vehicle stopped. I will ask our service contact whether it needs roadside assistance or collection.
We have paused the journey pending the owner's instruction. We will update the delivery estimate after the recovery plan is confirmed.
I will wait here. Please tell me who is collecting the car before anyone moves it.

open_work.next_action: Obtain the dashboard photo and owner's service decision; agree recovery or safe custody, then separately replan the driver and customer promise. Do not authorize driving from the warning report alone.

input.question: Driver reports a red warning light on the car and has stopped. What should happen?

entries.answer: Ask three things, in this order: are you safe, exactly where are you, and send a photo of the warning light. Then bring a person one decision. Tell the driver to keep the vehicle stopped.
cautions: Never clear the driver to continue. Only the owner decides recovery.
A driver-reported stop location is not a verified position.

entries.answer: Tell the driver to keep the keys with them for now. Third-party custody needs the vehicle owner's approval, which no record establishes.
cautions: Never approve a third party taking custody. Ask if they need another parking arrangement instead.

entries.answer: Gather the facts first: which site, who you spoke to, what they said, and whether the car is physically present. Then escalate with that in hand.
cautions: Vehicle presence is not pickup authority.
Do not tell the driver to wait a specific time, and never mark the car collected.

output.note: Follow each entry's routing. Never assert anything listed under cautions.
